notes.title: Patch 1.2 - Dynamic Shadows, New Balance, and More!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Mercenaries! ✊

It's been a while! We've been busy with cooking and we're excited to finally share a brand new 1.2 update for Crimen!

We’ve packed in a bunch of new features and improvements to make your experience even better. Here’s a breakdown of what's new: 

- Dynamic Shadows & Lighting: Immersive lighting that brings every scene to life.
- 4K Textures: Sharper textures that make every detail pop.
- Metallic Effects on Weapons: Your arsenal will now shine in all its glory.
- New Balance: We’ve tweaked the gameplay for a smoother and more engaging experience across the board.
- Quest 3 Sharper Visuals: Quest 3 users can now enjoy higher pixel density, delivering a much sharper image. 
- More Foliage: Explore environments packed with even more plant life for added immersion.
- General Bug Fixes: We've squashed bugs and resolved issues reported by the community to ensure a more polished experience.
- Optimization: Improved overall performance for smoother gameplay on all platforms.
Your feedback has been nothing short of incredible! Every suggestion, bug report, and review helps us refine the game and create a more enjoyable experience for everyone. We truly appreciate your dedication! Keep the feedback coming, and we'll keep delivering the best adventures possible!

Thank you for supporting us and keep on adventuring!
